body: I strain my ears, the sound of the horn echoing through the salty air. The ship's lights flicker, and the crew hurries about, preparing for departure. My stomach tightens as I feel a chill run down my spine. I glance around, but no one seems to notice me. I quicken my pace, the ferry's wake churning the water beneath me. I don't want to be here when the ship finally leaves.
